purpose: Teach: 右足/ピル/人妻/男児/牙/疾走/歓喜/先導

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、右足麻痺のリハビリを医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Ren, we'll handle your right-foot rehabilitation as a coordinated medical team.
lines.style: Steady, clear delivery. No condescension. Direct eye contact. Slight pause before the clinical detail — showing care even in professionalism. Warm at the edges.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、ピル処方のカウンセリングを医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Yes, we'll provide counseling on your medication prescription as part of that care.
lines.style: Calm, reassuring tone. Measured pace. A gentle nod embedded in the voice — she's heard this concern before and answers it without impatience. Steady.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、人妻の妊娠相談も医療チームで配慮します
lines.en: Ren, if you're expecting — whether it's your first pregnancy or a return — we'll handle all of that with care too.
lines.style: Soft openness. No assumption or judgment in the voice. Slight warmth on 'care' — she means it. Professional but not distant. Room for the patient to exist fully.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 男児出産の医療を、貴院、丁寧におこなわれますね、先生
lines.en: It sounds like your hospital does this kind of work with real attention to detail, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Quiet respect underneath. Tentative but genuine — he's testing whether the confidence he just heard is real. Slight lift at the end, genuinely asking. Hopeful.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、動物の牙による咬傷を医療チームで処置します
lines.en: Yes, if an animal bite comes through, we manage that as well — the medical team handles it immediately.
lines.style: Same steady confidence as before. No alarm, no minimizing. Clinical certainty delivered gently. Professional competence without swagger.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、疾走中の心拍を医療チームで観察します
lines.en: Yes, during physical exertion we monitor the heart rate continuously — it's part of how we keep people safe.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact clarity. Slight warmth on 'keep people safe' — the real reason underneath the protocol. Calm, no urgency needed because she's done this a thousand times.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 患者の歓喜表情を、貴院、観察されますね、先生
lines.en: I notice your hospital really does watch what patients are going through — not just the medical facts but how they're feeling, don't you?
lines.style: Softer this time. He's moving from intellectual observation toward something personal. Careful phrasing — not quite a question, almost a statement of wonder. Quiet vulnerability.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療チームの先導役は経験豊富な医師が務めます
lines.en: Yes, and I make sure the most experienced people on the team lead that observation — they know what to look for.
lines.style: Quiet confidence in her people. Not defensive, just factual. Slight emphasis on 'experienced' — she knows this matters. Voice stays warm and direct. A small assurance.
